title: WhatsApp Messaging Limits Are Portfolio-Wide: GoHighLevel Update
desc: Meta sets WhatsApp messaging limits at the portfolio level, shared across every number. GoHighLevel now shows the real quota. The tier ladder and the traps.
keywords: whatsapp messaging limits, whatsapp business messaging limit, gohighlevel whatsapp limits, whatsapp portfolio messaging limit, whatsapp tier 250 limit increase
cta: Want your GoHighLevel WhatsApp setup planned around the real quota?
body:
August 27, 2026. HighLevel updated on August 27 how WhatsApp messaging limits appear in sub-accounts, replacing the per-number limit column with a single portfolio-level panel. The interface change matters because of the policy underneath it: Meta's messaging limits documentation confirms the limit is calculated and set at the business portfolio level and shared by every phone number in it, which HighLevel says took effect on October 7, 2025. If your account still plans WhatsApp volume number by number, the quota you are planning against does not exist.

How WhatsApp messaging limits actually work now

  1. One shared ceiling. The limit is the number of unique customers you can message outside the 24-hour service window in a moving 24-hour period, and Meta's documentation states plainly that one number can consume all of the portfolio's capacity.
  2. The ladder starts at 250. New portfolios begin at 250 unique recipients per day. Reaching 2,000 requires completing a scaling path: verify the business, have a partner verify it, or send 2,000 delivered messages to unique recipients over a rolling 30-day period using high-quality templates.
  3. Above 2,000 is automatic. Meta raises the limit one level at a time, within about 6 hours, when quality is high across all numbers and templates and the business has used at least half its current limit in the last 7 days. HighLevel's summary of the ladder runs 2,000, then 10,000, then 100,000, then unlimited.
  4. Downgrades are gone, and that cuts both ways. HighLevel notes the old flagged state no longer knocks a limit down. Low quality now blocks you from scaling up instead, so a bad template no longer costs capacity you have, it silently costs the capacity you were about to get.
  5. New numbers skip the warm-up. A new phone number added to a portfolio inherits the portfolio's current limit immediately, and on cutover existing portfolios kept the highest limit among their numbers.

What HighLevel changed in the app

Sub-accounts get a Messaging Limits panel under WhatsApp Settings showing the true portfolio-level number, the misleading per-number column is removed from the Phone Numbers view, and a tooltip spells out that one number can burn the whole quota. The panel ships in 13 languages. This follows the pattern of HighLevel's recent WhatsApp work, like the username changes covered earlier this month, where the platform is mostly catching its interface up to decisions Meta already made.

What it means for operators

The trap is any portfolio with a marketing number and a support or notifications number side by side. A promotional blast from one can exhaust the shared quota, and the transactional messages that customers actually wait for start failing with no warning that traces back to the other number. Plan campaigns against the portfolio ceiling, not the sending number. The second trap is counterintuitive: because automatic scaling requires using at least half your current limit over 7 days, cautious under-sending postpones the raise you are waiting for. Teams we set up for lead generation on GoHighLevel get a volume plan that clears the utilization bar with room to spare while every template stays inside quality thresholds, because quality is judged across all numbers and templates together, so one sloppy template gates the entire portfolio's growth.

How to check your real limit

In HighLevel, open the sub-account's WhatsApp Settings and select Messaging Limits. Outside HighLevel, the same figure sits in WhatsApp Manager under Account tools, and API users should note Meta deprecated the old messaging_limit_tier field, so custom dashboards need to request whatsapp_business_manager_messaging_limit instead. If a dashboard you built last year still reads the old field, it is the per-number illusion with an expiry date.
faqs: Are WhatsApp messaging limits per phone number or per business?

Per business portfolio. Meta's documentation states the limit is calculated and set at the portfolio level and shared by all phone numbers in it, so one high-volume number can consume the entire daily quota for every other number in the portfolio.
How do I increase my WhatsApp messaging limit from 250 to 2,000?

Complete one of Meta's scaling paths: verify your business, have your partner verify it, or send 2,000 delivered messages to unique recipients over a rolling 30-day period using templates with a high quality rating. Meta then reviews message quality before approving the increase.
Why has my WhatsApp limit not increased above 2,000 automatically?

Automatic scaling requires two things at once: high quality across all your numbers and templates, and use of at least half your current limit within the last 7 days. Under-sending is the common blocker, since a portfolio that never reaches 50 percent utilization never qualifies for the next level.
Where do I see my WhatsApp messaging limit in GoHighLevel?

As of the August 27, 2026 update, open the sub-account's WhatsApp Settings and select Messaging Limits. The panel shows the portfolio-level limit that actually governs sending, and the old per-number limit column has been removed because individual numbers no longer have their own quotas.
